crossRefs.note: He answered, “I have not troubled Israel; but you, and your father’s house, in that you have forsaken Yahweh’s…
So Ahab went up to eat and to drink. Elijah went up to the top of Carmel; and he bowed himself down on the earth, and…
Are there any among the vanities of the nations that can cause rain? Or can the sky give showers? Aren’t you he, Yahweh…
Yet he didn’t leave himself without witness, in that he did good and gave you rains from the sky and fruitful seasons…

translations.web: He prayed again, and the sky gave rain, and the earth produced its fruit.
translations.bsb: Again he prayed, and the heavens gave rain, and the earth yielded its crops.
translations.kjv: And he prayed again, and the heaven gave rain, and the earth brought forth her fruit.
translations.asv: And he prayed again; and the heaven gave rain, and the earth brought forth her fruit.
